User Roles

📅 Published June 2025 📂 Platform: Keytelemetrics 👤 Audience: Administrators

Roles control what a user can see and do on the platform. They define access rights at a granular level — for example, allowing a user to list assets but not create or edit them. Roles can be created at both Vendor and Client level.

Default: The only built-in role is Administrator, which grants full view and edit access to everything the user has visibility of.

1. Creating a Role

Navigate to Administration → Accounts → Roles, then click the + button to open the User Role Wizard. Enter a Name and Description, then click Next:

Selecting Access Rights

Choose the access rights for the role from the options available. Each area can be granted List and/or Create permissions. Some areas have additional granular rights such as Poll, Toggle Outputs, and Upload Parameters for Devices:

AreaAvailable Rights
User RolesList, Create
UsersList, Create
Cost CentresCreate
Asset CategoriesCreate
Asset GroupsCreate
AssetsList, Create
DevicesList, Create, Poll, Toggle Outputs, Upload Parameters
SIM CardsList, Create
Device ProvidersList, Create
SMS GatewaysList, Create
ZonesList, Create
AnalyticsView
ReportsRun
AlertsList
Custom FieldsNone / Create
Tip: Create roles that match your team's job functions — e.g. a "Fleet Viewer" role with List only, a "Fleet Manager" role with List + Create, and a "Technician" role with device-specific rights such as Poll and Toggle Outputs.

2. Completed Role

Once saved, the role appears in the list with its description and all assigned access rights visible in the detail panel. This can be edited at any time:

3. Assigning a Role to a User

A Role can be assigned to a user in two ways:

MethodHow to Do It
During user creationAfter completing personal details in the User Wizard, the next screen presents role selection — choose the role before finishing
Editing an existing userGo to Administration → Users, select the user, click Edit on the User Roles section, and select the appropriate role
Bulk assignmentSelect multiple users (Ctrl+click), open Settings, and assign a role to all at once
Note: If no custom roles have been created yet, only Administrator will appear in the role selection list. Create your roles first before creating users.
